title: tec.h: header-only testing for C (and C++) without the ceremony
excerpt: Drop one header in. Write a test. Compile. Run. That's the whole product. I got tired of unit testing in C feeling like a side quest with its own build system, package manager, and personality. So I wrote [tec.h](https://github.com/ShashwatAgrawal20/tec.h).

title: My First Linux Kernel Patch (and How You Can Land One Too)
